newsitem.title: MEXICO: Banco de Mexico outlines quarterly credit limits.
newsitem.headline: Banco de Mexico outlines quarterly credit limits.

text.p: Banco de Mexico on Thursday outlined its quarterly limits for net domestic credit, minimum growth of net international assets, and growth of the monetary base for 1997.
Intl Assets Monetary base Net domestic credit**
NOTE -- All of the above are accumulated flows in billions of dollars or pesos, as indicated.
*The average estimated exchange rate used for net
international assets is 8.53 pesos per dollar.
**The limit on net domestic credit is seen falling by at
least the indicated amounts, the central bank said.
